title: Initial Configuration Satisfies the Tape Bounds
statement: Let $m$ and $k_D$ be the numbers of program and auxiliary tapes, respectively, let $x$ be an input word, and let $W,B$ be natural numbers. For any program state $l$, register valuation $v$, output word, and state set, the configuration obtained by taking the initial arithmetic configuration with all registers valued according to $v$ and then adjoining $k_D$ blank auxiliary tapes has each program-tape head position between $-1$ and $W$, and each auxiliary-tape head position has absolute value at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: arbitrary input word, program state, register valuation, output word, and state set
